description.value: Chad's Pizza is a local pizza shop on Lougheed Highway in Maple Ridge, serving a broad menu of pizzas, pastas, wings, calzones, salads, and desserts. A 'Create Your Own Pizza' option lets cyclists fuel up exactly to taste, while combo deals offer a filling meal in one order. Dine-in, counter pickup, and delivery through DoorDash, Uber Eats, and SkipTheDishes are all available.

address.value: 22358 Lougheed Highway, Maple Ridge BC V2X 2T4
